p2_3_prices_source: A cheap first year doesn't mean cheap forever — many suffixes renew at several times the promo price. This table compares registration and renewal for 408 popular TLDs (live Porkbun prices first, ≈ static reference when unavailable). Click headers to sort, click a suffix for its full guide.
Live prices from Porkbun; CNY estimated at 7.2. ≈ marks static reference prices. Registrar prices vary — confirm on the registrar page.
